title: Hatsune Miku — Become The Understudy!〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Event: On the Stage of Dazzling Light

rows.Line: Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Tsukasa was so surprised when he heard that I'd be his understudy for Thorpe☆

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But I still don't really get why he always seems so down or why he gets so nervous that he can't play the piano.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hmm... For now, I just gotta keep getting to know Thorpe better!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Starting with the audition scene!
Oh, the composer's there too, so I'll just play both at once♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
“Let's start the audition.
First up, Thorpe. Show us what you got.”

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Ba-da-da-dum♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: “Thank you!”

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Oh no...!
I forgot to stay in character! That was just me talking!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I don't get it. Playing the piano's so much fun. How can Thorpe get so nervous that he can't play it...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That goes for how much I love being in shows too. I don't think I've ever felt nervous or anything like that...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hmm...
A few hours later

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hmmmm...
A few more hours later

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hmmmmmm...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Gwah...
I don't understand how Thorpe feels at all!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I know! I can just ask KAITO...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, wait...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: At the same time, Tsukasa needs to take care of this on his own if he wishes to grow as an actor.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That's right! Tsukasa's trying really hard, so I have to do the same!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hnnnng...
A few hours later

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hmm... Out of gas...

rows.Speaker: Birdie Plushie
rows.Line: Oh no! Did Miku collapse?!

rows.Speaker: Tanuki Plushie
rows.Line: What happened? She seems really tired.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Oh, Birdie! Tanuki!
Actually...

rows.Speaker: Birdie Plushie
rows.Line: Oh, okay. You were learning more about this character...

rows.Speaker: Tanuki Plushie
rows.Line: You should take a break for now, Miku. In the meantime, we can think for you!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You will?! Thank you both so much!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But this is something I need to do on my own in order to grow as an actress.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: So your kind words should be more than enough right now♪

rows.Speaker: Birdie Plushie
rows.Line: Okay! That's so amazing of you, Miku!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Heh heh heh. That's just who I am☆

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Wait, hold on...?
Think for me...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: In my place...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That reminds me of when Nene originally needed Robo-Nene to perform in shows...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I remember her saying how she ran into some trouble with her old troupe and became too scared to perform in front of others.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hold on...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (Thorpe's never been able to pass an audition for a band.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (I know it's because he has trouble playing when it matters most... But the root cause of that has to do with him getting too nervous...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: “What if I fail again when it matters...?”

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: “If I do, everything that I've been doing until today would go to waste...”

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: “More importantly, I'll just end up wiping the smiles off the faces of everyone in the crowd...!”

rows.Speaker: Birdie Plushie
rows.Line: Whoa! It's like you just turned into a totally different person, Miku.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Really?!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
How's practice going, Miku?
If Thorpe's giving you any trouble at all...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: KAITO! You gotta hear this! I just...!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I see. Nene and Robo-Nene, huh...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Instead of looking for what I have in common with Thorpe, you thought about what Nene has in common instead.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yup!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, wait... This sorta means I cheated, huh?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
No, I don't think so.
It's just another way of comprehending a character.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Really?! Thank goodness!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Hehe☆
In that case, I think I've gotten to know Thorpe a lot better♪

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hehe. You'll probably get to know him very well if you keep this up.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yup! I'm gonna keep doing just that! Here we go!
